CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Annunciation.
   C. Say The Annunciation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
